question.prompt: When the solution set \(-1<x\le3\) is represented on a number line, there is an open circle at \(-1\) and a filled dot at 3. What is the sum of all integers in this solution set?

solutions.explanation: The integer solutions are 0, 1, 2, and 3 (\(-1\) is excluded), and their sum is \(0+1+2+3=6\).
solutions.title: List and add the integer solutions
